response.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_tg, AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND TG IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: High means WBC strictly greater than 6.5. A record with WBC exactly 6.5 is not counted as high.
Both averages are taken over the same set of records, so records with a NULL TG are excluded. That means the WBC average only covers high-WBC records that also have a TG value.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute each average independently over all high-WBC records. AVG ignores NULLs on its own, so the WBC average also includes records where TG is missing.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_tg, AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5

alternatives.interpretation: Compute each average independently over all high-WBC records. AVG ignores NULLs on its own, so the WBC average also includes records where TG is missing.
